newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak Jan real ind output +2.0 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Slovak Jan real ind output +2.0 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Slovak real industrial output in January rose 2.0 percent, year-on-year, after an 11.2 percent real, year-on-year rise in the same month of 1996, the Statistical Bureau (SUSR) said on Tuesday.
SUSR added in a statement that real construction output was up 1.4 percent year-on-year, in January, compared to a real 7.9 percent year-on-year increase in January 1996.
